Diancie

Rock Fairy

Kalos · Generation 6 · Mythical Pokémon

Diancie is a Rock/Fairy-type Jewel Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 8.8 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Defense (150), with a base stat total of 600.
